definitions.explanation: Indicates that a task, process, or action has been fully completed. Commonly used in administrative, technical, and digital contexts as a status label.

examples.japanese: {作業|さぎょう}は{完了済|かんりょうず}みです。
ダウンロードは{完了済|かんりょうず}みになっている。
{報告書|ほうこくしょ}の{提出|ていしゅつ}は{完了済|かんりょうず}みですので、{次|つぎ}のステップに{進|すす}んでください。
examples.english: The report submission is already completed, so please proceed to the next step.

notes:
Compound of {完了|かんりょう} (completion) + {済|す}み (finished). Technically redundant since both {完了|かんりょう} and {済|す}み convey completion, but the combination is standard in status labels and administrative language. Very common in digital interfaces, project management, and official documents.

Used as a no-adjective modifier: {完了済|かんりょうず}みの{手続|てつづ}き (completed procedures).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手続|てつづ}き{完了済|かんりょうず}み: procedures completed
- {設定|せってい}{完了済|かんりょうず}み: setup complete
- {検査|けんさ}{完了済|かんりょうず}み: inspection completed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {完了|かんりょう}: completion — the base word, sufficient on its own in many contexts
- {済|す}み: done; finished — shorter suffix form, also used alone as a status marker
- {処理|しょり}{済|す}み: processed — a similar compound indicating a specific action has been finished
